## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible change and why it is needed. Link the related issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. State unverified boundaries.
For efficiency claims, link sanitized matched-run evidence rather than synthetic fixtures.

## Compatibility and risks

Mention schema, installation, permissions, dependencies or data-handling changes.

- [ ] The change preserves unrelated edits and recorded evidence.
- [ ] Relevant behavioral tests or documentation checks pass.
- [ ] Private data and unsupported performance claims are excluded.
